description: Start/stop a movie export with named VJ/editorial presets (HAP, HAP Alpha, ProRes 422/4444, NotchLC, MP4 review) while reusing record_movie's Movie File Out TOP recorder. This records a TOP to a file written by TouchDesigner and documents the expected codec/extension/fps for downstream playback tools.

action.description: Start or stop the preset recording pass.

file.description: Output movie path on the TD machine. Required for action=start.

node_path.description: Path of the TOP to record.

preset.description: Delivery preset to document and apply.

seconds.description: Optional fixed loop duration. Omit to record until a stop call.

name: export_render_preset
title: Export render preset
